description: Given a refresh token, issues new ID, access, and optionally refresh tokens for the user who owns the submitted token.

incidents.description: What the March 2026 Threat Technique Catalog update means for your AWS environment

securityImplications: Attackers might use GetTokensFromRefreshToken with a stolen Cognito refresh token to silently mint fresh ID and access tokens, maintaining access to the victim's account while the legitimate user's session continues normally.
